meaning: Locator-bearing evidence directly treats the exact concept set as one bounded historical configuration.
mandatory_condition: Evidence, rights, coherence, review, and product-policy gates must all pass.

meaning: A documented same-case source bundle coherently supports the complete group without unsupported bridges.
mandatory_condition: Every synthesis step and scope equality must be explicit; unrelated pair sources are forbidden.

meaning: Direct group evidence and compatible composite evidence jointly support the exact bounded configuration.
mandatory_condition: Direct and composite claims must be separately traceable and mutually scope-compatible.

meaning: Some or all pair claims are supported, but the group has not passed independent global-coherence review.
mandatory_condition: No group-active or product-active status; pair records remain separately governed.

meaning: The structure has bounded research value but unresolved evidence, authority, sense, rights, or review requirements.
mandatory_condition: May be exposed only through an explicitly research-only path.

meaning: Reviewable material does not support the proposed exact group.
mandatory_condition: Record searched sources, locators, and rejection reasons.

meaning: Concept labels share metadata, source, category, or passage without one coherent configuration.
At least one member sense or time/place/institution/actor/case/mechanism scope conflicts with the group.
mandatory_condition: Split or reformulate only through a new candidate identity.

meaning: The proposed roles, order, or render topology are unsupported or contradictory.
mandatory_condition: A semantic group may survive only with corrected separately governed realization.

meaning: Direct negative evidence defeats the exact proposed group under its bounded scope.
mandatory_condition: A negative pair blocks pair projection but does not automatically defeat a separately supported hyperedge.

meaning: The candidate has been generated but one or more mandatory review gates are incomplete.
mandatory_condition: Any pending candidate blocks candidate-universe closure.

meaning: The candidate duplicates an exact canonical participant, role/order, scope, and authority identity.
mandatory_condition: Point to the surviving candidate; never merge merely overlapping or nested groups.
